title: AI Influencer Studio launch
excerpt: We're launching on Product Hunt on December 31st! Our AI influencer studio is up and running. See how
analysis: The post opens with a product reveal line. That label comes from the post text, not from watching the video. Reported 199 views and 8 likes on the gallery listing, a like rate of 4.02 percent, above the library median of 0.56 percent. At 36 seconds it compares best with the 30 second structure.
